⬆ Import from CSV / Excel

Export your Excel spreadsheet as CSV (File → Save As → CSV), then paste the CSV content below, or drag & drop the file. Map your columns to the correct fields below.

📂

Click to select a .csv file or paste CSV data below

Column Mapping

Map your spreadsheet columns to EMS Lead fields. Use Edit Fields to add or rename mapping options.

EMS Field Options
These are the options shown in the "Maps to EMS Field" dropdowns. Built-in fields cannot be deleted. You can add custom fields or rename built-in labels.
Field key: lowercase, underscores ok, no spaces (e.g. district_name). This becomes the property name on each lead.
Your Column (CSV header) Sample Data Maps to EMS Field
⚠ Duplicate Handling
When the same company name appears more than once — either in this file or matching an existing lead — each row's site info will be treated as a separate building/location on that company.

🌡️ Import Weather Data — CSV
Upload all weather data for your ZIP code
Data is stored by ZIP and automatically applied to all meters in this building. HDD, CDD, and average temperature are matched directly to each normalized calendar month.
Expected CSV columns:
month, year, hdd, cdd, avg_temp
Month can be a name (January, Jan) or number (1–12). avg_temp is optional. One row per month. Re-importing updates existing months.
